account.note: RE-PULLED LIVE AT 15:21 ET BY THE LAST HOURLY BEFORE THE FUSE, against the mandated account after a scope preflight that matched the mandate identifier EXACTLY AS A STRING against the connector list - one match, no first-account default, no nickname match, no balance heuristic. Every other account was discarded unread and none is summarised, totalled or mentioned in this file, in runs.json, in why.json, in the commit message or in the operator report. Portfolio, equity positions and option positions were each queried live and all three returned first time: 1011.15 total against 1011.15 cash, buying power 1011.15, equity_value 0, options_value 0, futures 0, crypto 0, pending_deposits 0, unsettled 0.0000. THE BALANCE IS UNCHANGED FROM THE 14:21, 13:21, 12:21, 11:21 AND 10:21 MID-SESSIONS, THE 09:45 OPEN AND THE 9/1 CLOSE - the fourteenth consecutive identical read. The 1.99 credit the 9/1 open flagged as an unexplained non-trading item remains STABLE and remains FLAGGED rather than explained; this run also found no endpoint asserting a cause and does not assert one. THE WHOLE BALANCE IS SETTLED, so no good-faith violation is reachable and the live MDT specification claims 372.28 at its limit - 371.48 at the 92.87 offer it would actually fill on - which is 36.7% of deployable, comfortably inside both the settled balance and the 40% single-name ceiling. BOTH POSITION LISTS ARE EMPTY, so no +20% target, no -8% equity stop, no -40% option stop, no ~5 session time stop and NO OPTION NO-FLY WINDOW is reachable - each checked live this hour rather than inherited from the 14:21 run. ZERO equity orders and ZERO option orders on a 2026-08-26 created_at floor confirm the flatness is not a stale read AND confirm the 09:45 MDT specification is UNEXECUTED rather than resting unfilled at the broker - which matters more on this pass than on any before it, because the limit has now been continuously fillable for 71 minutes and an execution would show here.

entryWatch.setup: MDT day-2 continuation after the 9/1 beat-and-raise - the name the 9/1 file flagged as worth this open's attention if it built a shelf. It built it. Medtronic reported fiscal Q1 2027 on 2026-09-01 am, EPS 1.45 against a 1.39 estimate, a 4.3% beat, with revenue 9.756B against 9.545B, FY27 EPS guidance raised to 5.94-6.00 and organic growth guidance raised to 7.25-7.75%. The 9/1 reaction bar opened 94.00, ran 95.41, flushed to 90.80 and closed 92.04 on 18.8M shares against roughly 6.5M typical - a faded gap that nonetheless HELD 1.53% above the 90.65 pre-print close, which is the exact line SAIC and NTNX failed. The afternoon based 92.24-92.96 for four hours. Today opened 91.47, below yesterday's close and below that base, held above the 90.80 reaction low, and reversed to a 93.39 high. SPECIFIED at 09:45 at a 93.07 limit for 4 shares, CLEAN, no checklist item marked fail, struck AT THE OFFER rather than under the bid as the direct correction to yesterday's DG failure.
entryWatch.trigger: STILL MARKETABLE, AND MORE SO THAN LAST HOUR. RE-QUOTED AND CONFIRMED FOR A SIXTH AND FINAL HOUR ON THE LAST HOURLY BEFORE THE FUSE, NOT KILLED. MDT is 92.86 bid / 92.87 ask at 2026-09-02T19:21:34.681693447Z, last 92.870, +0.90% against a 92.04 settled close, on a 0.01 spread that is 0.011% of mark. THE 93.07 LIMIT NOW SITS 0.20 ABOVE THE OFFER against 0.06 above it at 14:21, so the specification fills immediately at 92.87 - twenty cents inside its own limit and fourteen cents better than the 93.01 the last run quoted. The level has been continuously fillable since the 18:10Z bar, 71 minutes against twelve last hour, and every one of the fourteen bars since has traded at or through it. The limit is NOT LOWERED to bank the improvement, on the same rule and the same symmetry that kept it from being RAISED through two hours of the name running to a 94.605 high: confirming a specification is not improving it. All four invalidations re-checked against the tape and none fired - the session low is still the 91.47 opening print, unbroken across seventy bars with the bid 1.52% above it, nothing near 90.80, no close below 90.65 possible before 16:00, and MDT green so the relative-strength test has not triggered and structurally CANNOT before the 15:30 fuse, since it resolves only at the 16:00 close and therefore binds a filled position rather than this proposal. THE COUNTERWEIGHT SPLITS THIS HOUR AND BOTH HALVES ARE RECORDED. The peer RANK RECOVERED - MDT is now THIRD of five medtech names behind ABT +1.82% and BSX +1.03% and ahead of BDX +0.69% and ZBH +0.52%, having been LAST of five an hour ago - but it recovered on a collapsing field rather than on any strength of its own, MDT falling 0.13 points while BSX fell 0.84, ZBH 0.72 and BDX 0.46. MEANWHILE THE BENCHMARK ALPHA DEGRADED FOR A SECOND CONSECUTIVE HOUR AND IS NOW ESSENTIALLY EXTINGUISHED: XLV rose again to +0.84% while MDT fell again, the second straight hour of a rising denominator against a falling numerator, leaving 1.08x against XLV from 1.19x and 1.96x against SPY from 2.16x - the first sub-2x reading of the day. MDT has now fallen in four consecutive hourly reads. Not a kill condition and not treated as one: the named invalidations are four specific tests and a decaying ratio is not among them, and inventing a stricter test in the last ten minutes would be rule drift in the direction nobody audits. The honest sentence stands and has strengthened - the level was reached because the name WEAKENED, and an operator filling now buys, at a limit struck when MDT was the strongest medtech on the board, a name whose relative-strength case has largely evaporated. Setup intact 2.21 above the 90.65 pre-print close. Cost 371.48 at the offer against 1011.15 fully settled, 36.7% of deployable. Expires 15:30 ET; operator notified at 15:21 with seven minutes left, the final ping before the fuse.
entryWatch.why: The primary case is the day-2 structure off a beat AND raise, not the cohort. That ordering is deliberate: yesterday's DG entry rested on a cohort-laggard framing that inverted by 14:22 while the spec sat unfilled, so the sympathy-laggard reading is available here but is written down as a secondary tailwind rather than the load-bearing claim. Also recorded before the outcome: eight price-target raises landed in one pre-market (Mizuho 100-115, Leerink 104-111, Evercore 105-106, Wells Fargo 102-104, Baird 91-100, Truist 86-99, Stifel 80-95, Jefferies 88-95) with a mean target of 101.74 - which sits BELOW the mechanical +20% take-profit at 111.68. This trade most likely closes on the time stop rather than the target, and it says so at entry rather than discovering it at the retro.

entryWatch.setup: DG discount-retail reclaim - the 9/1 specification at a 128.40 limit that expired unexecuted at 15:30
entryWatch.trigger: NOT RE-STRUCK, AND THE REFUSAL IS RE-AFFIRMED FOR A FIFTH TIME TODAY. Quoted at 09:45 at 131.94 bid / 132.37 ask, leaving the dead 128.40 limit 2.68% below the market; not re-quoted this hour because nothing this slot could learn about DG would make re-striking it permissible, and a row this run did not re-pull does not get this run's clock. The 2026-08-18 rule is explicit that widening the time was never permission to widen the price. What the companion case did this hour is come the rest of the way back: MDT's limit now sits 0.42% under its bid against 1.16% two hours ago, so on one of the two names the identical refusal is close to being rewarded outright rather than merely stopping a chase. That is the outcome this row has been waiting for on both, and it is recorded on the hour it looks good only because it was also recorded on the hours it looked expensive.
entryWatch.why: Kept as the standing example. The spec died VALID rather than wrong - none of its three invalidations fired - and it still did not fill, because it was struck 0.38% under the bid of a name that rose on every bar. Today's MDT entry is struck AT the offer for that reason, and this row is what that decision is answering.

entryWatch.trigger: REFUSED. OLLI is 75.67 bid / 76.15 ask at 2026-09-02T13:41:39.019258805Z, last 75.964, +4.60% against a 72.34 settled close, on a 0.63% spread. A 22.4% beat - 1.42 against a 1.16 estimate, reported this morning - and it is refused for three reasons that stack: TODAY IS ITS REACTION BAR and the rulebook buys the day-2 or day-3 pullback that holds, not the print bar; the two sessions into it whipsawed hard, 8/31 closing +4.3% at 75.42 and 9/1 giving all of it back to 72.34 at -4.1%, so there is no shelf to strike against; and FIVE reports tonight into the same discount-consumer complex, which lands inside any five-session hold opened today. Worth the 9/3 and 9/4 opens' attention if it builds a shelf, on the same terms SAIC was given and failed and MDT was given and passed.
entryWatch.why: Recorded as the runner-up rather than dropped, because a mandated entry that does not name what it beat is not gradeable. If MDT fails and OLLI runs, this row is the evidence for whether the reaction-bar refusal was the right call or a reflex.

entryWatch.setup: SAIC post-earnings round-trip - the control case that gives the MDT setup its meaning
entryWatch.trigger: STILL REFUSED, AND STILL BREAKING DOWN. SAIC is 123.11 bid / 124.39 ask at 2026-09-02T13:41:55.491665676Z, last 123.50, -2.90% against a 126.78 settled close, on a 1.03% spread. That is a third consecutive lower session and it remains below its 125.96 pre-print close and below the 127.10 low of its own reaction bar. A 30.9% beat has now fully round-tripped and kept going.
entryWatch.why: This is the row MDT is graded against. Same shape at the start - a large beat, a gap, a fade - and opposite resolutions: SAIC lost its pre-print close on day 2 and MDT held 1.53% above it. The rulebook has no rule that says 'a big beat is a buy'; it has a rule about what the tape does with the gap, and these two names are the worked example of why.
